expectation: The messengers will help the cells start using muscle instructions, possibly producing an RNA copy.

reaction: The picture makes the difference between copying instructions and making proteins clearer.

alternatives.reason: I could start the other RNA goal first, but I can continue the muscle path now.

effect: The muscle cells now contain pulling proteins that can slide to shorten the cells; the support-protein path remains.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the RNA instructions become a structure with a job.
reason: The supporting-cell messengers are pictured activating support-protein genes in the unspecialized cells, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The messengers will lead to RNA copies of the support-protein instructions.

effect: The supporting-cell messengers produced RNA copies, but the fibres around the cells have not been built yet.
reaction: The parallel with the muscle pathway makes the next step clearer.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and the cells now have instructions for support proteins.
expectation: The cells will use the amino acids to make supporting fibres around themselves.

effect: The support cells made protein fibres around themselves, completing the chapter. Unlike the muscle cells, they released protein into their surroundings.
reaction: The contrast between proteins inside and outside cells made the two paths easier to understand.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the pulling proteins was most worthwhile: the picture connected the RNA instructions to fibres that can slide and shorten a cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second RNA-copying path felt somewhat repetitive after the muscle path, though it helped show the comparison.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cells with the same DNA could make proteins for such different jobs, including fibres outside the supporting cells.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: the messenger pictures named the genes they activated, and amino acids were identified as protein building blocks. How the messengers cause those genes to become active was not explained in detail.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, especially to see how the separate muscle cells become larger fibres and contribute to movement.
